additions.name: Ruti
additions.note: Women's clothing boutique from Israel, open in Town & Country Village since November 2009. The store is still listed at 855 El Camino Real #45.

additions.name: Sweet 55
additions.note: Swiss chocolate shop at Town & Country Village. Palo Alto Online reported a June 17, 2022 grand opening for the Palo Alto store at 855 El Camino Real Suite 123, and a November 2026 Peninsula shopping guide still lists SWEET55 at Town & Country Village.

additions.name: Coyuchi
additions.note: Organic bedding and home-goods store at Town & Country Village, opened in November 2022. A current listing still places it at 855 El Camino Real, Suite 5.

additions.name: Sushi House
additions.note: Japanese restaurant in Town & Country Village. A current Palo Alto directory lists Sushi House at 855 El Camino Real Suite 158 and dates it to 1988 at the same address; a 2015 student restaurant guide also says it opened in 1988.
